grains.RAW.SELLERS: one row per marketplace seller (city and product category)
grains.RAW.SELLER_DAILY: one row per seller per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.COMPLIANCE_DOCUMENTS: one row per seller (compliance document snapshot)
grains.CURATED.ISSUE_SUMMARY: one row per order issue type

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day marketplace-wide order-issue FORECAST; return rate ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.ISSUE_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic order-issue handling SOPs (one per product category and issue type)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.MARKETPLACE_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.MARKETPLACE_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, seller, issue-type and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (sellers, daily order issues, cancelled orders by seller, order-cancellation risk, order events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_ORDERS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_ORDER_ALERT logs new ISSUE events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.cancel_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(cancelled order for the seller in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
